description:
## Why
fixture_purposes.tsv (attached to fz-p8p) drafts a purpose for all 433 numbered files. Files no earlier step touched still need processing.

## What changes
Each remaining file gets its purpose, a `main` if it has none (92 files lack one), and moves to `fixtures/`. Misdescribing stems are renamed (00510, 00298, 00524, 00287); one of the two 00556 files is renumbered; exact duplicates merge; unreferenced 00011, 00012, 00028 are deleted unless a claim adopts them.

## Signal
No numbered .fz files left directly in fixtures2/.
title: Move the remaining numbered fixtures2 files to fixtures/
